correctness.rationale: The Artin–Schreier cover has a single pole of order 8 prime to p=5; genus g=(p-1)(8-1)/2=14, and a 14-differential basis x^i y^j dx with 5i+8j<=26. The unrooted Cartier matrix entry M_{(u,l),(i,j)}=(-1)^{j-l} binom(j,l)[x^{5u+4}](x^i F^{j-l}) is a polynomial over characteristic five. Four constant pivots reduce first rank to 4+rank[[2a,a²+2b],[-2b,-2e]] with determinant proportional to Δ=ae+2a²b-b²; its rank 2,1,0 produces first ranks 6,5,4. Frobenius-twisted products M^[5]M, M^[25]M^[5]M, M^[125]M^[25]M^[5]M have ranks as stated: b!=0 gives 3,1,0; b=0 gives second rank 1 exactly at ae^5+1=0 and 2 otherwise, higher zero. The characteristic-five polynomial identities in the inspected verify_cartier.py support the all-algebraic-closure assertions. Independent construction and direct rank multiplication for seven F5 tuples checked all listed special profiles, including the codim-two anomaly; these finite checks do not themselves prove the infinite-field result.
